claim: The final spectral+GW170817 and dark+GW170817 public posterior samples are not identical; the frozen C10 comparison is a valid descriptive output comparison.
The preregistered Phase4 primary result is partial: 10 of 12 comparisons are valid and C11/C12 are public-output-limited because the bright-only artifact is grid+density rather than direct samples.
The release-documented GW170817 grid-density conversion can be reproduced as a deterministic post-hoc diagnostic, but it does not restore C11/C12 as preregistered primary results.
Population modeling is a direct methodological dependency of the published standard-siren H0 routes; Branch01/05/07 connect only partially or structurally under the frozen cross-branch map.
The project can identify public-output dependence and provenance boundaries without determining which H0 value is physically correct.
basis: Claim boundary and zero new-cosmology-inference audits.
